messages:
alex: hey @runtime — marketing needs a very small reproducible benchmark for the launch deck and webinar dry-run. can you run a compact smokepack and sanity sweep and tag it 'launch-smokepack-1717'? need numbers we can cite: p50/p95 text gen latency, coldstart delta, embed+rerank tail, and token cost per response.

maria: +1 — please include three model configs: rdm-fp16 (control), rdm-q8, rdm-q4. cohorts: short (<=64 tokens), mid (65-512), long (1024+). sample set: marketing_seedset_2025_v1 (seed=7). keep it privacy-safe.

jay: quick question: do you want warm-only results, cold-only, or both? we can do a 2-pass: warm (5 warmup requests per pod) then idle 12min and capture coldstarts.

alex: both please. warm pass labeled "warm-5"; cold pass labeled "cold-12m". also include a tiny reproducible package (3 examples per cohort/variant) for the press kit. non-sensitive only.

kevin: noted. We'll log per-request metadata: variant, cohort, pass_label, seed, pod. we'll also capture KV cache hit rates and any fallback to fp16. Example trace tag we'll add: `run=launch-smokepack-1717 variant=rdm-q8 cohort=short pass=cold-12m seed=7`.

ops: runtime-bot: job created: JOB-1717; est ETA for short+mid cohorts: 4h, full including long: 28h. will prioritize short first for your deck.

maria: timeline question — we need a summarized CSV and a 1-slide summary for the webinar rehearsal in 24h. raw traces can follow but summary + 3 sample payloads required in 24h.

jay: we can provide a compact CSV with p50/p75/p90/p95, mean token cost, and a tiny heatmap of coldstart percentiles. we'll include notes on server-side prewarming (how many tokens/warmup count) and whether prefix caching persisted.

alex: also: if any config causes >15% regressions vs fp16 on p95, flag it and include the raw request ids for inspection. marketing will not claim numbers about variants that degrade.

kevin: agreed. we'll include an "exclusions" section in the manifest if we see anomalies. we'll also generate `smokepack_manifest.txt` with sha256 hashes for the exported artifacts.

maria: one more: please record the exact command(s) you run so engineering can reproduce locally if reporters ask. small runbook snippet is great.

jay: will attach run commands in JOB-1717. starting short cohorts now. posting results to #marketing and uploading artifacts to the internal bucket `gs://redwood-launch-artifacts/JOB-1717/`.

alex: perfect — thanks team :rocket:
